name: Protect live installations
rationale: User: live rooms and furniture stay fixed during routine refresh.

name: Fit the display format
rationale: Whole panels require matching nominal format; waterfall may use a verified cut from a larger slab.

name: Exclude discontinued products
rationale: A discontinued product cannot be proposed for a new installation.

name: Add missing designs first
rationale: User: use scarce movable slots to broaden the range.

name: Reduce repeated finishes
rationale: Repeats can remain for bookmatch or a distinct useful finish/application.

name: Give Hit products prime exposure
rationale: User examples: Oro Noir and Tuscano Burgundy. Visibility tiers need a Merch/site review.

name: Keep color families together
rationale: Group family/temperature and order light to dark. Initial ranks are image-derived suggestions.

name: Minimize disruption
rationale: Prefer a product swap within an existing compatible fixture before moving its frame.

name: Protect the central route
rationale: Illustrative keep-out strip, not an accessibility/building-code dimension. Design must supply verified geometry.

name: Release only complete work packages
rationale: A visual proposal may contain missing data. Ordering/installing must expose and resolve those gaps.
